constructor.details: Initial owner & fee recipient = CurveYield Safe. Fee starts at 0.      The owner can set the fee to any amount <= immutable maximum.

params.maximumCreationFeeWei_: Absolute fee ceiling, in native gas-token wei.        Fraxtal deployment parameter: 1 ether (1 native FRAX, 10**18 wei).
params.vaultFactory_: Existing native Morpho Vault V2 factory on the target chain.

createAdapter(address).details: Native fee is transferred immediately to the configured recipient.      This contract does not custody Vault V2 assets or approve markets.

transferOwnership(address).details: Ownership administration ONLY for fee/deployer settings.      It does not confer any privileges over Vault V2 or deployed adapters.

createAdapter(address).notice: Deploy one adapter for an existing official Vault V2.
